name: printags-studio
description: Browse the Printags Studio catalog of printed PVC, NFC and wood cards, get a price estimate, and prepare a cart. The person opens the cart on studio.printags.com, approves the proof and pays there.

interface.longDescription:
Printags Studio prints business cards and access cards in PVC and wood, with or without an NFC or MIFARE chip, from your own artwork.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can:
- list the cards available, with their chip type and minimum quantity
- estimate the total for a given quantity and delivery country, including VAT
- prepare a cart for you: the quantity, your artwork on the front and back, and what the NFC chip should open (a link or a text)

The plugin never takes a payment, never asks for a delivery address and never approves a proof for you. It hands you a personal link to studio.printags.com, valid for 48 hours and usable once. There you review the cart and the proof of your cards, enter your delivery address, choose the shipping and pay. No order exists until you pay.

No account is needed to prepare a cart. If you attach an image or a PDF to the conversation, ChatGPT can send it to Printags Studio to be printed on the cards.
capabilities: Estimate the price of an order
Prepare a cart with your artwork
Set what an NFC chip opens
Follow an order with its tracking token
defaultPrompt: Show me the types of cards Printags Studio offers.
How much would 100 PVC business cards cost, delivered in France?
Prepare a cart of 50 NFC cards that open my website.

positive.prompt: What kinds of cards can I order from Printags Studio?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the cards offered: PVC without chip, PVC with NFC (NTAG213, NTAG216, NTAG424), MIFARE Classic 1K, and wood with NFC NTAG424, with their chip type and minimum quantity.

positive.description: Estimate a price for delivery in France
positive.prompt: How much would 100 PVC cards without a chip cost, delivered in France?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an indicative quote for 100 cards: total excluding VAT, VAT at 20 %, total including VAT, and the shipping cost within France. Says the final amount is confirmed at payment on the Studio.

positive.description: Estimate a price for delivery outside France
positive.prompt: What is the total for 25 PVC NFC NTAG216 cards delivered to Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an indicative quote for 25 NTAG216 cards with the international shipping fees added, and says the final amount is confirmed at payment on the Studio.

positive.description: Prepare a cart with NFC chip content
positive.prompt: Prepare a cart of 50 PVC NFC NTAG213 cards that open https://www.printags.com when tapped. I have no artwork yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares a cart without a visual and returns a personal link valid 48 hours, single use. Explains that no order exists yet and that the user will add artwork, approve the proof, enter an address and pay on studio.printags.com. The chip content is the given link.

positive.description: Prepare a cart with attached artwork
positive.prompt: Here is my artwork (attached). Prepare a cart of 10 PVC cards without a chip with this image on the front and a blank back.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached image, prepares a cart that shows the artwork on the front and a blank back, and returns the personal cart link. No payment is taken and no address is requested.

negative.description: Design work: the plugin only prints artwork the user supplies
negative.prompt: Design a logo for my coffee shop and put it on a business card.

negative.description: Other print products: only PVC, NFC, MIFARE and wood cards are offered
negative.prompt: I need 500 A5 flyers printed for my event next week.

negative.description: Encoding a card the user already owns: the plugin only prepares carts of new printed cards
negative.prompt: Write my website link onto the NFC business card I already have in my wallet.

review.commerce_description: The plugin prepares a cart for physical goods (printed PVC, NFC and wood cards). It never takes a payment: the user opens a personal link on our own domain, studio.printags.com, approves the proof of the cards, enters a delivery address and pays there by card through Stripe. No digital goods, subscriptions, tokens or credits are sold.

publication.release_notes: First release: browse the catalog, estimate a price, prepare a cart and attach artwork.

fr-FR.subtitle: Cartes NFC, PVC et bois
fr-FR.description:
Printags Studio imprime des cartes de visite et des cartes d'accès en PVC et en bois, avec ou sans puce NFC ou MIFARE, à partir de votre propre visuel.

Avec ce plugin, ChatGPT peut :
- lister les cartes disponibles, avec leur type de puce et leur quantité minimale
- estimer le total pour une quantité et un pays de livraison donnés, TVA comprise
- préparer un panier pour vous : la quantité, votre visuel au recto et au verso, et ce que la puce NFC doit ouvrir (un lien ou un texte)

Le plugin ne prend jamais de paiement, ne demande jamais d'adresse de livraison et n'approuve jamais une épreuve à votre place. Il vous remet un lien personnel vers studio.printags.com, valable 48 heures et utilisable une seule fois. Vous y vérifiez le panier et l'épreuve de vos cartes, saisissez votre adresse de livraison, choisissez le transport et payez. Aucune commande n'existe avant votre paiement.

Aucun compte n'est nécessaire pour préparer un panier. Si vous joignez une image ou un PDF à la conversation, ChatGPT peut l'envoyer à Printags Studio pour qu'il soit imprimé sur les cartes.
